name: shared-repo-guard
description: For repos where several AI agents (or you and an agent) work in the same folder: stops secret values from leaving your .env, pushes to public remotes, and git commands that would wipe work this session did not write.

publicRemotes.title: Public remotes
publicRemotes.description: Remote names that must never be pushed to, comma separated (for example: public, mirror)

envFiles.title: Extra .env files
envFiles.description: More .env files to watch, relative to the repository root, comma separated (for example: apps/web/.env.local). Every .env* file at the root is watched already.
